articles.summary: MIAMI --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Mar. 19, 2026-- World Kinect Corporation (NYSE: WKC) announced today that its board of directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, which is payable on April 16, 2026 to shareholders of record on March 30, 2026.
articles.title: World Kinect Corporation Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend
